{{Top|leg}}
The '''Barralenal''' were a group of exiled [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] pilgrims that colonized the [[Trans-Nebular sector/Legends|Trans-Nebular sector]]. Around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], the sector was also colonized by a group of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]], and a [[Corellian/Aqualish war|war]] broke out between the two.
